description: TPO 803 A2  group of Leyandii to fell to ground level at the rear garden.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The removal of deadwood, dangerous / hanging branches and ivy:  This does not require the formal consent of the Council.

Statutory crown lifting of trees: This does not require formal consent of the Council if the clearance only involves the removal of branches to give a separation between the footway and the tips of the lowest branches by up to 2.3m or the carriageway by up to 5.2m.
The group of early mature Leylandii trees are situated in the rear of the property. They are in a fair condition and can be see by neighbours. For these reasons, they have a moderate amenity value.
Removing the trees will remove all amenity that they provide. Light issues are not a strong enough reason to remove a group of healthy trees.
The specification is refused due a lack of arboricultural reasons.
